requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the SQL filter includes all classes from A1 to C. The area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), location (Turin) and public transport requirements are not energy-related columns and were not extracted.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface must be >= 850.
User explicitly wants a location near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
